text:
elaine.marketing: Quick sync — finalizing benchmark narrative for the launch post + webinar. Need agreed chart set and 2 headline lines for landing page. Goal: make latency vs cost story easy for engineers and procurement. Thoughts?

nate.growth: I think 3 focused visuals work best: 1) p50 & p95 latency vs tokens/sec (line), 2) cost per 1k tokens across model + quantization variants (bar), 3) cost vs SLO hit-rate (scatter). Keep hero simple.

sam.pm: Agree on p50 + tail callouts. Also we should include a tiny methodology blurb: workload slices (chat, code, rerank), prompt lengths distribution, batch sizes. Helps credibility.

margo.design: I can mock these. For hero copy idea: "Same quality, 3x lower inference cost at p50" — is that defensible?

elaine.marketing: Don't assert 3x universally. Use "up to 3x" and show stratified numbers per workload. Add a small note: "results vary by model, prompt length, and caching".

zoe.salesops: Routing note: flag inbound leads that ask about "cost savings >20%" as ECON leads and route to growth AE. We need 2 email variants: technical (bench details + charts) and exec (savings, CTA).

bench-bot: Perf run summary uploaded. Models tested: vicuna-13B-8bit, orca-7B-4bit, redwood-v1-smol. Median latency on A100s, batch=1, prompt=512 tokens. CSV: https://internal.sheets/b/bench-march-24

sam.pm: Can we get a condensed table: model | quant | cost / 1k tokens | p50 | p95 ? That feeds slides, email bullets, and the landing callouts.

nate.growth: Email subject tests: technical -> "Benchmark: Latency × Cost tradeoffs for low-latency apps"; exec -> "How Redwood reduces LLM inference costs for production". CTA variants: "Estimate my savings" vs "Request enterprise demo".

margo.design: I'll produce a hero mock + 2 social thumbnails (400x400) and a 3-chart slide by EOD. Need the small table CSV and 2 headline options from copy.

elaine.marketing: Draft hero copy: "Inference that scales — lower your per-request bill without sacrificing responsiveness." Subhead: "Benchmark-driven recommendations for batching, KV caching and quantization." Open to punchier variants.

zoe.salesops: Also add a short lead form field: "approx monthly token volume" so we can give an immediate savings estimate. Route those to ECON tag.

sam.pm: Callout for Dedicated: highlight "predictable latency" and "SLA-backed options" rather than specific numbers until legal clears.

elaine.marketing: Agreed — legal will review. For public materials say "SLA-backed options available".

nate.growth: Timeline: design mock by EOD, final copy tomorrow AM, staging page next Wed, webinar next Thu. Owners: margo.design, sam.pm (copy), zoe.salesops (routing), nate.growth (promo).

margo.design: Got it. Will upload mocks to /design/bench-launch by 5pm and ping here.

bench-bot: Reminder: include raw bench CSV + reproduction script snippet in repo: `tools/bench/run_bench.sh`

elaine.marketing: Thanks all — I'll consolidate into a one-pager after mocks land. If anyone has a hot take on messaging (hero or email subject), drop it here before EOD.
